name: Unitree Robotics (宇树科技)
description: Research target. Hangzhou-based robotics company; world's largest quadruped robot maker and a leading humanoid robot vendor (H1/H2, G1/R1). Listed on the SSE STAR Market (688836.SH) on 2026-08-19 — the first pure humanoid-robot stock on the A-share market.

name: NVIDIA Corporation
description: AI compute leader. Chose Unitree as hardware partner for the Isaac GR00T Reference Humanoid Robot (GTC Taipei 2026-05-31): Unitree H2 Plus body + Jetson AGX Thor; GR00T platform also supports Unitree G1.

name: Meituan (美团)
description: Chinese local-commerce platform. Largest external institutional shareholder of Unitree pre-IPO via three concert parties (Hanhai Information, Galaxy Z, Chengdu Longzhu) holding 9.6488% combined; strategic interest in humanoid robots for local-life scenarios.

name: Tencent Holdings (腾讯控股)
description: Chinese internet conglomerate. Direct C-round (2025-06) investor in Unitree via Tencent Technology, holding 2.17917M shares pre-IPO (~0.54% post-issue), focusing on AI model + robot integration.

name: Alibaba Group (阿里巴巴集团)
description: Chinese e-commerce and cloud conglomerate. C-round (2025-06) investor in Unitree via wholly-owned Hangzhou Haoyue (1.6343M shares); affiliate Ant Group via Shanghai Yunchang (0.8172M shares).

name: UBTech Robotics (优必选)
description: Shenzhen humanoid robot maker (Walker S series), listed on HKEX (9880.HK). Direct competitor of Unitree in China's humanoid market — UBTech leads industrial deployments (BYD, Geely factories) while Unitree leads volume and research-market share.
